feasibility: Broad class if gearing and motor selection fit
principal_gate: Actual loaded bus range rather than nominal motor voltage

assumed_bus_or_path: Illustrative variable input 15-60 V; output set by pack state up to 42/54.6 V
feasibility: Broadest direct-DC reuse candidate
principal_gate: Motor and pack qualification; protection across conversion crossover

assumed_bus_or_path: Intact rear direct-drive e-bike on stand; raw phases routed externally
feasibility: Selected bikes only
principal_gate: Break-before-make motor-controller separation; approved pack charge port; assist disabled

assumed_bus_or_path: Intact bike with supported regen controller and compatible BMS
conversion_required: ACTIVE REGEN CONTROLLER; not the generic DC/DC path
feasibility: Selected bikes only
principal_gate: Continuous charging limits rather than short braking peaks; no accidental motoring

feasibility: No generation through its own motor
principal_gate: Need mechanically coupled rollers or external generator

assumed_bus_or_path: Typical intact mid-drive with no verified rotor back-drive path

conversion_required: GENERATOR CONVERTER + BUFFER + INVERTER + OEM CHARGER
feasibility: Broad battery-interface route; mechanical fit still model-specific

feasibility: Generic downstream buck not guaranteed
principal_gate: Headroom and exact charge profile; excitation draw accounted

principal_gate: Low-voltage input current limit; excitation losses; qualified receiver

assumed_bus_or_path: Smart alternator without supported standalone commands

assumed_bus_or_path: 24 V system alternator to 28.4/54.6 V battery profile
conversion_required: NEAR-UNITY or BOOST depending on actual regulated output
feasibility: Low priority
principal_gate: Exact regulated voltage; net human-power output; battery profile
